DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (Myalgic Encephalomyelitis)

Since your B12, folate, and other standard metabolic screens are normal, and your previous COPD diagnosis appears to be a misinterpretation given the normal lung imaging and gases, this clinical picture of unexplained fatigue lasting three months with normal workup is most consistent with Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
